messages:
zoe: kicking off canary for hera13b-int4; seeing intermittent OOMs and 99p tail at higher concurrency (>3).
ashwin: can you share exact flags (batch_max, batch_timeout_ms, prefetch, max_new_tokens, eviction)?
zoe: flags:
model=hera13b-int4; batch_max=8; batch_timeout_ms=25; prefetch=true; max_new_tokens_default=256; soft_eviction=false; kv_slots=32
maria: mixed short/long prompts historically amplify KV fragmentation; long sessions create big KV pages that fragment under prefetch.
drew: queued quick perf matrix (batches 1,2,4; max_new 64,128,256; prefetch on/off).
ml-eval-bot: results: prefetch=on batch=4 max_new=256 -> OOM x3, 99p~820ms. prefetch=off batch=4 max_new=256 -> OOM x1, 99p~560ms. prefetch=off batch=2 max_new=128 -> no OOM, 99p~240ms.
ashwin: suggests safe canary defaults: batch_max=4; batch_timeout_ms=15; prefetch=false; max_new_tokens_default=128; soft_eviction=true. Apply to hera-canary pool.
zoe: deployed to hera-canary (10 instances), running synthetic mix 30% long prompts @QPS120.
ml-eval-bot: 60m interim: 0 OOMs, 99p=240-290ms, occasional 320ms spikes.
maria: ablation toggling soft_eviction off reproduced OOMs; re-enabled.
ashwin: file INFRA ticket for telemetry to detect sequential large-kv allocs per session (alert if >3 in 2s) and auto-rollback threshold.
zoe: INFRA-9890 opened and onboarding note added: "mixed-length models: start with prefetch=false and conservative max_new_tokens until memory profile validated".
drew: QA run on canonical prompts shows no meaningful degradation (metric deltas <0.7%).
zoe: TL;DR: root cause = prefetch + large max_new + concurrent batches -> KV fragmentation -> sporadic OOMs and tail. Mitigation = conservative defaults + soft_eviction + telemetry + gradual rollout. Plan: 24h clean canary then 50% pool rollout. Closing thread.
